C17 and C04 share terminology for executive departments and independent establishments and concern federal compensation, while C21 broadly directs federal agencies, but those are generic institutional references rather than a concrete drafting template for the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the several executive departments, independent establishments, and other governmental agencies","parent_excerpt":"the several executive departments, independent establishments, and corporations","explanation":"C17 uses a similar enumeration of federal entities, but only as routine language defining which organizations administer compensation."},{"child_excerpt":"all employees in the Federal service","parent_excerpt":"every executive department, independent establishment, and wholly owned Government corporation shall pay ... each of its employees","explanation":"C04 also regulates federal employees across agencies, but its detailed compensation system bears no structural or operative resemblance to a one-time holiday excusal order."},{"child_excerpt":"other agencies of the Government","parent_excerpt":"the departments, agencies, and independent establishments of the executive branch of the Government","explanation":"C21 shares only a generic reference to executive agencies and supplies no closure, leave, or employee-excusal mechanism."}]}
